design: Capture normalized inputs and MLP writes in layers0,1,2 at fourfixedpositions on256historical documents. Fit each local predictor on768states/192discovery documents; evaluate256states/64confirmation documents. No output activation supplied to predictor.
models: Mean baseline; rank16/rank32 input PCA then linear or full degree2 polynomial ridge prediction of1152dimensional write. PCA, feature centering/scaling and target mean fit on discovery only. Fixed ridge penalty0.01 in mean squared standardized-feature objective; no validation model selection.
metrics: 1-sum squared prediction error/sum squared deviation from training target mean; negative scores allowed. Also output-PCA oracle rank32 for compression-only comparison, explicitly given true output.
limits: Teacher supplies native local input; not replacement of full attention+MLP block or first-three-layer prefix. Quadratic student is an empirical polynomial surrogate, not a semantic explanation. Existing development documents reused. Fourpositions perdocument not independent samples.
holdouts: Only H998discovery/confirmation subset of original historical BSFtraining documents; original BSFvalidation/test not used.
